title: A small, straightforward process.
description: You work directly with the person designing and building your site from first conversation to launch.

steps.title: Talk
steps.description: We get clear on your business, your customers, and what the website needs to accomplish.

steps.title: Design
steps.description: I turn that direction into a focused design that looks professional and sounds like you.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: The approved direction becomes a responsive, lightweight website.

steps.title: Launch
steps.description: After a final review, your new site goes live and starts working for your business.
